# hetznerrobot_boot_vnc (Resource)

Activates a VNC-guided installation of a dedicated server. **The installation wipes the server.** It starts on the next reboot — pair it with `hetznerrobot_server_reset` — after which Robot reports `active = false`; the resource keeps that as a fact. Only one boot configuration can be active at a time. Destroying the resource deactivates the installation if it is still pending.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Starts a VNC-guided installation on the next reboot — this wipes the server.
resource "hetznerrobot_boot_vnc" "installer" {
  server_number = 321
  dist          = "Fedora-40"
  lang          = "en_US"
}

output "vnc_password" {
  value     = hetznerrobot_boot_vnc.installer.password
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dist` (String) Distribution to install over VNC (see `hetznerrobot_boot.vnc_dists`).
- `lang` (String) Language of the installation, e.g. `en`.
- `server_number` (Number) Server to configure.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the configuration is still pending. Robot clears it once the server has booted it.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Root (or Administrator) password Robot generated on activation. Only the activation answer carries it, so it stays as it was after the configuration is used up.
- `server_ip` (String) Main IP address of the server.
- `server_ipv6_net` (String) Main IPv6 net of the server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Only a pending (still active) activation can be imported.
tofu import hetznerrobot_boot_vnc.installer 321
```
